comparison.objective: Load four connector modules into a spring-open hinged frame and squeeze it shut until it clicks; candidate screens media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated narrow-support placement while preserving neighboring modules, followed by spring-frame closure versus pouring and controlled agitation.
comparison.success_condition: All four modules seated, frame clicked shut and hands ≥3 cm clear for 1 s; candidate requires ≥98% recovered media, every washer retained and no spill.
comparison.reason: The frame task tests cumulative insertion and latching rather than granular flow through a mesh.
